what: Name spots in the text that have not been revealed yet are masked with eight ▓▒░ characters and re-rolled every .5s. On click, a bundle of speech bubbles forms over it from blur 8px · 1.05 times · transparent in .8s with a bouncy curve (.2,-.25,0,1.6) — the first bubble shows typing dots for 1s → speech for .5s → the second bubble rises from 10px below in .25s with typing dots for 1.5s → speech, and 2s later the bundle scatters with the same curve. .5s after it closes, it returns to the first stage

options.steps: Step durations (sec, comma-separated) — two slots per bubble, typing and speech, default 1,0.5,1.5,2
options.reset: Delay before resetting to the first step after closing (sec), default .5
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-gap: Group open/close duration, curve and gap to the text line (style), default .8s · cubic-bezier(.2,-.25,0,1.6) · 16px
options.[data-fx-part=chat] > [data-fx-part=bubb: (Optional) Speech bubble group and bubbles — text to show after the bubble text finishes typing

from.where: index.html .ll-redact — original RedactedText: 8 characters ▓▒░ with setInterval 500, on press an ease-bounce .8s bundle (invisible · opacity 0 · blur · scale 1.05 → visible), stages [1000,500,1500,2000], resets to 0 500ms after closing, balloon reveal-xs (.25s, 10px), dots animate-pulse delayed 0·100·200ms

note: With reduced motion, masked text stays as is and the group switches on and off immediately
